name: didomi-consent-or-pay
comment: Hides the Didomi notices that autoconsent's didomi rule leaves alone because rejecting costs a subscription. Nothing is clicked and no consent is stored: the banner is hidden again on every visit.

detectPopup.exists: xpath///button[@id='didomi-notice-disagree-button'][contains(., '€') or contains(., '£') or contains(., '$') or contains(., 'uscri') or contains(., 'ubscri') or contains(., 'bonn') or contains(., 'bbon')]
